user.title: Sign in to ecobee
user.description:
Open this link in a **desktop browser** and sign in to ecobee:

{authorize_url}

Use a desktop browser, not your phone — on Android the link opens the ecobee app instead and you will never see the address you need.

After signing in your browser will land on a page that fails to load. That is expected. Copy its full address from the address bar, then continue.

code.title: Paste the address you landed on
code.description:
Paste the full address of the page you were sent to after signing in. It starts with https://auth.ecobee.com/android/ and contains a `code=` value.

If you need the sign-in link again: {authorize_url}

error.state_mismatch: That address is from an earlier sign-in attempt. Start again and use the newest link.
error.no_code: That address has no authorization code in it. Copy the whole address, including everything after the question mark.
error.invalid_grant: ecobee rejected that code — they are single-use and expire after about a minute. Open the sign-in link above again and paste the new address; you do not need to restart setup.
error.auth_error: ecobee reported an error during sign-in.
error.cannot_connect: Signed in, but the security service could not be reached.

abort.already_configured: This home is already set up.
abort.no_homes: This ecobee account has no homes on it.
abort.no_security: No home on this account has Smart Security enabled.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different ecobee account than the one this entry was set up with.

init.title: Options

data.exit_delay_away: Exit delay when arming Away (seconds, blank to use the account's own setting)
data.exit_delay_stay: Exit delay when arming Home (seconds, blank to use the account's own setting)

init.description: The exit delay is set by this client, not by ecobee's servers — a delay of 0 arms the system the moment you press the button.
